Section B
Answer all the questions.
You may use the case study, your own enterprise experience and your knowledge of enterprise
where appropriate to answer the following questions.

text: A plan was developed with support from Social Enterprise S.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Starting a new enterprise always involves risk.
Discuss the various risks involved in attempting to make the Lighting Project a success.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The Lighting Project was funded by:
• donations made to Social Enterprise S
• profits made from the sale of lamps.
Evaluate the suitability of the above sources of finance, compared to a loan, for the Lighting
Project.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Cash flow is one element of financial planning for enterprises.
Discuss the importance of cash flow to the success of your enterprise project.

involves a number of parts, including the following:
• preparation

• negotiating your position
• reaching agreement.

success of any negotiations within your enterprise project.
